Behind the Buy: The Butterfly Effect ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE

One change. Every ripple.

How one procurement change ripples into schedule, payment and cash flow.

Choose a scenario to watch. Each one starts with the same kind of plan; one change sends it somewhere different.

What this training covers

One small change can reshape a government contractor's purchase. Four short, narrated scenarios show how: a specification change that reopens finished work, a reseller waiting on its manufacturer, payment terms that hide the real wait, and a billing cutoff that delays collection.

Illustrative only: examples, not benchmarks. Actual requirements depend on the contracts, regulations and company procedures.
